Schools and Teachers Innovating for Results (India) The Centre for Intrinsic Motivation (CIM), a flagship initiative of Schools and Teachers Innovating for Results [India] was established to address the issue of Quality Education. At CIM, we see teachers as integral towards achieving the goal of SDG4. Bronze Certified 2023 80G 12A CSR-1 Transparency Rating: Transparency Rating The transparency rating is calculated based on the amount of information available for the organisation. Is this your profile? Edit now . Send Message Overview PROGRAMS People ABOUT US Social --> Cause Area Primary Sectors Education Eco-system enabler Secondary Sectors Teacher Training Financials Geographies Served Programs Education Programme State Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi States Karnataka Tamil Nadu Delhi In Delhi, we are delivering the Teacher Development Coordinator programme in partnership with the Delhi State Council of Educational Research and Training (SCERT). Working since 2017, this programme covers every secondary school across all 11 districts of Delhi. In Karnataka, where we have been working since 2018, we are a named partner of the Department of State Educational Research and Training (DSERT) to deliver their ‘Kalika Chetharike’ learning recovery programme across every primary and upper primary school in the state. In Tamil Nadu, where we also started in 2018, we have recently signed a long-term memorandum of understanding (MOU) to work with Samagra Shiksha as a knowledge, implementation and management partner to provide assistance to state-level teacher professional development across every primary school in the state.
